assays.assay_description: Immediately after i.p. psilocybin (1 mg/kg) or saline, each rat was placed individually into a bedded cage and head twitches were counted for 15 min; sham and TBI rats.

application_type.evidence: a single intraperitoneal injection of psilocybin (1 mg/kg in saline)

setup_restrain.evidence: each rat was individually placed into a bedded cage

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the bedded observation cage during the 15-min count

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the bedded observation cage during the 15-min count

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately after treatment, each rat was individually placed into a bedded cage, and the number of head twitches... were counted for 15 min.

sample_size.evidence: The final injury group sizes were: sham (n = 21) and FPI (n = 25); per-treatment-group n not reported

outcomes.summary: A single 1 mg/kg psilocybin injection induced head twitches in both sham and TBI rats relative to saline; TBI did not alter the HTR.
outcomes.statistics: Kruskal-Wallis: H = 36.867, p < 0.001; Dunn's: sham/saline vs. sham/psilocybin p < 0.001; TBI/saline vs. TBI/psilocybin p < 0.001
outcomes.evidence: Dunn's post-hoc analyses revealed that psilocybin induced head-twitch responses in sham (p < 0.001) and TBI rats (p < 0.001; Figure 2A).

B1_num_measures.evidence: the number of head twitches... were counted for 15 min

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is excluded as ethological per rubric

B5_social.evidence: each rat was individually placed into a bedded cage

assays.assay_description: Sensorimotor test: training the day before treatment (5 trials on 100×4 cm beam, 5 on 100×2 cm beam), test 24 h post-treatment with 10 trials on 100×2 cm beam (max 60 s/trial); latency to cross and slips/falls measured.

application_type.evidence: a single intraperitoneal injection of psilocybin

setup_habituation.evidence: Rats were trained the day before treatment with five trials on a 100 × 4 cm beam, followed by five on a 100 × 2 cm beam.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats traverse the beam freely; no restraint described

food_restriction.evidence: No food on the beam apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: No water on the beam apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: Testing occurred 24 h post-treatment with 10 trials on the 100 × 2 cm beam.

sample_size.evidence: sham (n = 21) and FPI (n = 25); per-group n not reported

outcomes.summary: TBI/saline rats were slower to cross the beam than sham/saline (trial 5); psilocybin-treated TBI rats crossed faster than TBI/saline rats in trials 5 and 9. No effects on slips/falls.
outcomes.statistics: Trial 5: Kruskal-Wallis H = 9.048, p = 0.029; trial 9: H = 10.671, p = 0.014; Dunn's: sham/saline vs TBI/saline trial 5 p = 0.010; TBI/saline vs TBI/psilocybin trial 5 p = 0.016, trial 9 p = 0.035; slips & falls H = 2.383, p = 0.497
outcomes.evidence: TBI/psilocybin rats traversed the beam significantly quicker than TBI/saline rats in trial 5 (p = 0.016) and trial 9 (p = 0.035; Figure 2B). No effects of TBI or psilocybin on the number of slips and falls were observed.

B1_num_measures.evidence: time to cross the beam; number of slips and falls

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Performance analysed trial-by-trial across the 10 within-session trials (Table 1, Figure 2B); 'Repeated measures ANOVAs were used for... behavioral performance across trials'

B4_ethological.evidence: Beam traversal latency is a motor task measure

D1_continuity.evidence: Beam training data were analyzed... (see Table S1; Figure S1A); test 24 h post-treatment

D2_session_duration.evidence: 10 trials with a maximum time of 60 s per trial

D3_recording_days.evidence: trained the day before treatment; testing occurred 24 h post-treatment

D4_baseline.evidence: Beam training data were analyzed to ensure that... the rats later assigned to psilocybin or saline treatment did not differ prior to drug administration.

assays.assay_description: 5-min observation in well-lit circular arena (100 cm diameter, 66 cm central zone); time in centre, centre entries, velocity.

application_type.evidence: a single intraperitoneal injection of psilocybin

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were placed into the center of a well-lit, circular arena... and observed for 5 min.

time_to_assay.evidence: daily behavioral testing occurred for 1 week starting 24 h post-treatment (specific day not stated)

outcomes.summary: TBI reduced centre time (main effect, no significant post-hoc differences); psilocybin did not affect centre time or entries but had a significant main effect on velocity (direction not stated in text).
outcomes.statistics: Centre time: TBI F(1, 42) = 6.290, p = 0.016; psilocybin F(1, 42) = 0.259, p = 0.613; centre entries H = 5.890, p = 0.117; velocity: TBI F(1, 42) = 0.783, p = 0.381; psilocybin F(1, 42) = 5.984, p = 0.019; interaction F(1, 42) = 0.143, p = 0.708
outcomes.evidence: TBI decreased the time spent in the center of the open-field arena, but there were no significant post-hoc group differences (Figure 2E). Table 1: OFT velocity psilocybin effect F(1, 42) = 5.984, p = 0.019.

B1_num_measures.evidence: OFT time in center; OFT center entries; OFT velocity (Table 1)

B4_ethological.evidence: zone time and velocity are spatial/locomotor measures

E6_spatial.evidence: open field with virtual central zone (66 cm diameter)

D5_followup.evidence: Twenty-four hours after the treatment, daily behavioral testing occurred for 1 week

application_type.evidence: a single intraperitoneal injection of psilocybin

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats navigated a black circular pool

water_restriction.evidence: No drinking water available during swim test

time_to_assay.evidence: daily behavioral testing occurred for 1 week starting 24 h post-treatment (specific days for water maze not stated)

sample_size.evidence: sham (n = 21) and FPI (n = 25); per-group n not reported

outcomes.summary: TBI/saline rats took longer to find the platform than sham/saline in several acquisition and reversal trials; psilocybin-treated TBI rats were faster than TBI/saline in acquisition trial 4 and reversal trials 2 and 6. No group differences in swim speed or target quadrant time.
outcomes.statistics: Acquisition trial 1: H = 20.271, p < 0.001; trial 4: H = 12.196, p = 0.007; reversal trial 2: H = 15.835, p = 0.001; trial 6: H = 12.295, p = 0.006; Dunn's: sham/saline vs TBI/saline acq trial 1 p = 0.021, trial 4 p = 0.020; TBI/saline vs TBI/psilocybin acq trial 4 p = 0.029, reversal trial 2 p = 0.001, trial 6 p = 0.033; sham/psilocybin vs TBI/psilocybin acq trial 1 p = 0.006
outcomes.evidence: TBI/psilocybin rats found the platform significantly faster than TBI/saline rats in trial 4 (p = 0.029)... TBI/psilocybin rats showed significantly faster search times than TBI/saline rats in trial 2 (p = 0.001) and trial 6 (p = 0.033).

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same 8 behavioural assays; PET, MRI, IBA1 immunohistochemistry and body-weight/acute injury measures excluded as non-behavioural.
D5_followup set to Yes (score 1) for all post-24 h assays (beam, EPM, LDT, OFT, SPT, MWM, SIT) per rubric (>=24 h after last dose), overriding qwen/gemma's 'No'; HTR remains No.
Beam walk: accepted deepseek's D1=Multiple, D3=2 days and D4=Yes because the paper explicitly reports analysed pre-drug beam training data (Table S1, Figure S1A).
B2 temporal dynamics set to Yes for beam walk and water maze (trial-by-trial within-session analysis; 'All rats found the water maze platform faster over time'), overriding modal 'No'.
Water maze D2 set to 0/low: session duration not explicitly stated (rubric forbids inference); overrides modal 15–60 min.
SIT B6 set to Yes (social novelty phase requires recognition of familiar rat, analogous to NOR); B4 set to No (zone measures only), overriding gemma; B1 kept at 2-3.
HTR: B1 corrected to 0 (single measure), E1 Standard apparatus (separate bedded cage, not home cage), D2=1 (15 min inclusive).
SPT: E3 bedding set to 0/low (not stated in paper; overrides modal inferred Yes); D1 kept as Single session (24-h cumulative intake with bottle switch) while D2 >6 h and D6 Yes.

time_to_assay set to not_reported for EPM, LDT, OFT, MWM, SIT because the paper only states testing occurred daily over 1 week starting 24 h post-treatment without assigning days; beam (24 h) and SPT (4 days) are explicit.
OFT direction set to not_clear: psilocybin main effect on velocity (p = 0.019) reported without stated direction; no psilocybin effect on centre measures.
n_per_group_min left null: per-treatment-group n not reported (power analysis n=10 is a target, not actual). n_total 46 from final group sizes.
Age labelled 'adult': rats were 10 weeks at arrival but drug/behaviour occurred ~1 year after injury.
